entries.answer:
Úgy tűnik, nem csatoltál képet a kérdésedhez. Az alábbi kiegészített promptot azonban itt adom neked — **emberi képekre is teljes részletességgel kiterjesztve**, JSON kimenettel, magyarul és angolul egyaránt használható formában:

***

## Kiegészített, teljes képleíró prompt (JSON kimenettel, emberi arcra/testre is)

```
Examine the provided image and describe every single observable feature exhaustively.
No detail — however minor, subtle, or seemingly insignificant — may be omitted.

GENERAL SCENE:
- Overall composition, framing, aspect ratio estimation
- Background: colors, gradients, patterns, textures, objects, depth, blur/bokeh
- Foreground elements
- Lighting: direction, intensity, quality (hard/soft), color temperature, shadows, highlights, reflections
- Overall color palette and dominant hues
- Image quality: sharpness, noise, artifacts, compression

OBJECTS & NON-HUMAN ELEMENTS:
- Every visible object: shape, size (relative), color, texture, material (estimated), position, orientation
- Text/numbers: font style, size, color, language, placement, content
- Patterns: geometric, organic, repeating, irregular
- Spatial relationships between objects
- Any atypical, damaged, unusual, or ambiguous elements

IF A HUMAN PERSON IS PRESENT — describe EVERY detail at the MAXIMUM possible level:

FACE:
- Overall face shape (oval, round, square, heart, diamond, oblong)
- Skin tone (precise: e.g., light ivory, warm beige, deep brown, olive, golden, ruddy, pale, sallow)
- Skin texture: pores, smoothness, oiliness/dryness, visible pores, shine
- Wrinkles, fine lines: location (forehead, crow's feet, nasolabial folds, under-eye), depth, quantity
- Blemishes: acne, scars, freckles, moles, birthmarks — location, size, color
- Facial hair: presence/absence, density, color, distribution (mustache, beard, stubble, sideburns)
- Symmetry/asymmetry of facial features

EYES:
- Shape (almond, round, hooded, monolid, upturned, downturned)
- Size (large, small, average)
- Color (precise: e.g., deep brown, hazel with green flecks, light grey-blue, amber)
- Iris pattern, limbal ring visibility
- Pupil size (dilated/constricted, if visible)
- Sclera color (white, yellowish, reddish)
- Eyelids: thickness, fold, ptosis
- Under-eye: dark circles, puffiness, hollows
- Eyebrows: shape (arched, straight, bushy, thin, S-shaped), color, thickness, gaps, grooming state
- Eyelashes: length, density, curl, color, mascara/makeup
- Gaze direction and emotional expression conveyed

NOSE:
- Shape (button, bulbous, straight, aquiline, snub, broad, narrow)
- Bridge: height, width, bumps
- Tip: rounded, pointed, upturned, drooping
- Nostrils: size, flare, shape
- Columella visibility

LIPS & MOUTH:
- Lip fullness (upper/lower separately)
- Shape: cupid's bow, thin, wide, asymmetric
- Color: natural lip color (pink, red, brown, pale, dark)
- Texture: dry, chapped, smooth, glossy
- Lipstick/gloss: color, finish (matte, gloss, satin)
- Teeth: visibility, whiteness, alignment, spacing
- Expression: smile, neutral, open, closed

EARS:
- Size, shape, attachment (attached/detached lobe)
- Piercings: number, location, jewelry type

HAIR:
- Color (precise: e.g., jet black, ash blonde, chestnut brown, salt-and-pepper, dyed red)
- Highlights, ombre, roots visible?
- Texture: straight, wavy, curly, coily, kinky
- Length: very short, short, medium, long, extra long
- Style: loose, tied, braided, bun, ponytail, updo, parted (which side), fringe/bangs
- Volume and density
- Shine or dullness
- Any visible product (gel, oil, frizz)

BODY & POSTURE:
- Body type/build (if estimable): slim, athletic, muscular, curvy, stocky, petite
- Posture: upright, slouched, leaning, turned
- Visible body parts and their positioning (arms, hands, shoulders, neck, chest, legs, feet)
- Hand details: nail color, length, rings, veins, skin condition
- Neck: length, visible muscles, Adam's apple, jewelry

CLOTHING & ACCESSORIES:
- Every garment: type (shirt, dress, jacket, etc.), color (precise), pattern, fabric (estimated), fit (loose, tight, oversized), condition (new, worn, wrinkled)
- Visible brand logos or text
- Accessories: jewelry (type, metal, gemstones), watch (brand, style), glasses (frame shape, color, lens tint), hat, scarf, bag — all described in detail
- Shoes: type, color, material, condition (if visible)

EMOTIONAL & CONTEXTUAL READING:
- Apparent mood/emotion from facial expression and body language
- Estimated age range
- Apparent gender presentation
- Any cultural, professional, or contextual indicators (uniform, setting, props)
- Interaction with other elements or people in the image

OUTPUT FORMAT:
Provide your response as a structured JSON file with the following top-level keys:
{
  "scene_overview": {},
  "lighting": {},
  "background": {},
  "foreground_objects": [],
  "text_and_numbers": [],
  "persons": [
    {
      "person_id": "person_1",
      "face": {
        "shape": "",
        "skin_tone": "",
        "skin_texture": "",
        "wrinkles_and_lines": {},
        "blemishes": [],
        "symmetry": ""
      },
      "eyes": {},
      "nose": {},
      "lips_and_mouth": {},
      "ears": {},
      "hair": {},
      "body_and_posture": {},
      "clothing": [],
      "accessories": [],
      "emotional_reading": {},
      "estimated_age_range": "",
      "gender_presentation": ""
    }
  ],
  "color_palette": [],
  "image_quality": {},
  "atypical_or_ambiguous_elements": [],
  "contextual_clues": []
}

Be systematic. Examine major elements first, then progressively examine minor details, subtle textures, background context, and ambiguous features. Do not finalize your response until every visible pixel region has been considered. Provide values for every key — use "not visible", "not applicable", or "uncertain" where appropriate, but never leave a key empty without explanation.
```

***

Ez a prompt **minden lehetséges emberi részletet lefed** — arctól bőrtónuson, szemen, szájon, hajszerkezeten át a testtartásig, ruháig, ékszerig — és strukturált JSON formátumban adja vissza az eredményt, amelyet könnyen feldolgozhatsz programozottan is.
